name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump Stokes Islamophobia by Calling Democratic Candidates ‘Jihadists’
changes.summary: Along with his comments about Muslim candidates, Mr. Trump spoke disparagingly of Somalis in the United States, saying “they’re not smart.”.

changes.title: The FAA wants to reboot the nation's airspace. This airline shows how it might work
changes.summary: When Alaska Airlines wanted to optimize its operations, it turned to a small startup called Air Space Intelligence. Now the FAA has hired the company for a major reboot of the entire U.S. airspace. (Image credit: Joe Nicholson).

changes.title: How Cameras Can Track Every Car in the U.S., and Iran’s Catch-22
changes.summary: Plus, a drying river reveals Nazi-era vessels.

changes.title: Breaking down Iran's new set of demands over the Strait of Hormuz
changes.summary: Iran laid out a new set of demands for reopening the Strait of Hormuz as both the U.S. and Tehran are feeling the economic impacts of the conflict. CBS News' Courtney Kealy has more.

changes.title: Congressional Democrats to investigate efforts to deport U.S. military members and their families
changes.summary: The Pentagon declined to comment, stating it would "reply directly to the authors of the letter.".

changes.title: America Is Atomizing
changes.summary: A nation of us versus them and them and them.

changes.title: Flock Cameras Can Track Every Car in America. Police Love Them. Citizens Don’t.
changes.summary: In Texas, there’s one thing liberals and conservatives agree on: They don’t want cameras trained on their cars.

changes.title: Ocasio-Cortez says she's freezing her eggs as she considers her political career
changes.summary: The 36-year-old Ocasio-Cortez announced her decision on social media before explaining in an ABC "This Week" interview Sunday she has not ruled out running for president or for U.S. Senate.

changes.title: Thousands evacuated as wildfires burn across western U.S. and Canada
changes.summary: Wildfires are burning across the western U.S. and Canada, leaving some residents keeping a wary eye out for possible evacuation orders.

changes.title: How have the goals of the Iran war evolved?
changes.summary: The Iranian regime is now saying it will not reopen the Strait of Hormuz if the U.S. doesn't meet its demands, including compensation for the damage it has done in the more than five months since the start of the war.
